name: automd
description: Manage Kanban boards stored as markdown files. Create boards, add tasks, move tasks between columns, search across boards, and more.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: URL of your AutoMD server (e.g., https://automd.example.com)

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key for authentication. Generate one in AutoMD Settings > API Keys.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List all boards with task counts

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Get a board with columns and tasks

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to a column
